== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Herald]] of [[Redmoon Hall]], who insists on being called [[Redmoon]], is a leader of the [[Redmoon Hall]] sect. He possesses a distinct physical appearance characterized by scarlet skin, bright red hair, and crimson eyes, with white Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns resembling milky tears flowing from his eyes. He is described as having a massive ego and resides in a cavernous audience hall aboard the sect's mobile [[cloudship]] headquarters. [[Redmoon]] was formerly the [[Blood Shadow]] of the [[Sage]] known as [[Red Faith]], a relationship that resulted in him being considered a failed clone. He maintains Authority{{!}}authority over the sect's various agents and emissaries, who wear dark robes marked with a red moon.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Formerly known as the [[Remnant]] [[Redmoon]], this entity is also recognized simply as [[Redmoon]]. In their current union, the [[Herald]] of [[Redmoon Hall]] serves as the physical body to the mind of the [[Red Faith]]. This being possesses pink skin, crimson eyes, and scarlet hair, with white Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns trailing from the corners of his eyes. Despite this power, the [[Herald]] is unable to follow through space.}}
